message.content: According to the conversation, Sova mentioned that she is currently balancing strength training and cardio workouts. She expressed her desire to keep her cardio interesting and sought suggestions on how to achieve this balance. Later in the discussion, Sova shared that she enjoys a mix of different cardio activities, including interval sprints and joining group classes for a different vibe. This indicates that Sova plans to keep her cardio routine engaging by incorporating various forms of exercise, such as interval training and participating in group classes.
